features.label: Insert / screw holes
features.doc: Heat-set insert pockets or self-tap pilot holes.

features.label: Lid lip
features.doc: Keeps the lid square on the box.

features.label: Label and stamp
features.doc: Lettering on the side wall; revision stamp under the floor.

checks.label: 2 valid parts
checks.detail: OCCT validity check on the boundary representation.

checks.label: Interfaces as modelled
checks.detail: Measured on the built solid, not read from parameters: Boss hole diameter 4.000 · USB-C opening width 13.050 mm.

checks.label: Export mesh is closed
checks.detail: No open, non-manifold, flipped, duplicate or degenerate faces in the exported STL.

checks.label: STL matches the CAD solid
checks.detail: CAD 61.23 cm³, mesh 61.23 cm³. Guards against unit or tessellation errors in conversion.

checks.label: Fits the build volume
checks.detail: Bambu Lab A1 mini allows 176 × 176 × 180 mm with a 2 mm plate margin.

checks.label: Thinnest wall
checks.detail: Smallest opposing-wall distance over 75,601 surface samples. Under 0.8 mm cannot hold two perimeters on a 0.4 mm nozzle.

checks.label: Unsupported overhangs
checks.detail: Surface steeper than 45° from vertical, excluding flat ceilings and the plate face. Reorient, or confirm supports in the sliced preview.

checks.label: Flat ceilings
checks.detail: Flat downward faces above the plate print as bridges or need support. Inspect them in the slice.

checks.label: Plate contact
checks.detail: Flat area on the plate; height is 0.3× the narrowest footprint side. Stable first layer expected.

checks.label: Wall around M3 inserts
checks.detail: Boss Ø8.5 around a Ø4 hole. CNC Kitchen publishes 1.6 mm as the minimum wall for this insert (specified).

checks.label: Space above the board
checks.detail: Inner height − standoff − 1.6 mm board (assumed thickness). Check your tallest part (USB and Ethernet jacks on a Raspberry Pi stand about 16 mm).

checks.label: Slot pattern webs
checks.detail: 8 cells, 48% open. The thinnest web is 2.40 mm; two perimeters on a 0.4 mm nozzle need 0.8 mm. Thinner webs print as a single line or not at all.

checks.label: Fit within tolerance window
checks.detail: Expected total gap 0.70 mm (±0.36 at 2σ) against a window of 0.20–1.20 mm. USB-C plug width is specified; printer accuracy is assumed.

checks.label: Parts do not overlap when assembled
checks.detail: No overlap between any pair of parts (1 pair) in the assembled state: compared on the mesh (±0.10 mm), touching or overlapping pairs by boolean intersection of the solids.

checks.label: Smallest gap between parts
checks.detail: Parts rest on each other without overlap: Box / Lid.

checks.label: Assembly checks finished in their time budget
checks.detail: Every check above ran to the end. Time per stage: mesh 0.08 s, rest 0.13 s, fits 0 s, access 0 s.

checks.label: Re-imported in FreeCAD
checks.detail: FreeCAD 1.1.4: isValid() = True, 2 solid(s), volume 61.231 cm³ (Form Studio 61.231 cm³), bounding box within 0.0000 mm. Integration validation: FreeCAD and build123d both use the OpenCascade kernel family, so this confirms the STEP file reads back the same in another program; it is not an independent proof of the geometry.

fit.label: USB-C opening ↔ plug overmold
fit.model: Independent normal errors. Total gap = printed cavity − device. A model, not a measured success rate.

actions.title: Print the part
actions.why: The only physical proof. Sensible once the modelled yield is high.

actions.title: Print and measure the fit coupon
actions.why: This printer profile has no measured bias or spread; Form Studio is assuming them. The result is reused by every later design on this profile.

actions.title: Measure the usb-c plug width with calipers
actions.why: USB-C plug width is specified (±0.10 mm) and drives 31% of the fit uncertainty.
